title: Encoding & text
lede: Web-standard TextEncoder/TextDecoder for converting between strings and raw bytes. The single divergence from the browser API is scope: this is UTF-8 only. Because this compiler's strings are already raw UTF-8 byte sequences, encode/decode are direct byte copies with no real transcoding, and TextDecoder's optional label argument is validated against the UTF-8 aliases (a non-UTF-8 label throws a RangeError, since only UTF-8 is decodable). (atob/btoa and encodeURI(Component) live under global functions, not here.)

entries.name: TextEncoder
entries.description: Encodes a string to its UTF-8 bytes as a Uint8Array. UTF-8-only matches the spec exactly — TextEncoder is UTF-8-only by definition, so this is not a narrowing. Since strings are already stored as raw UTF-8, encode is a direct byte copy.

entries.name: TextDecoder
entries.signature: new TextDecoder(label?: string).decode(bytes: Uint8Array | ArrayBuffer): string
entries.description: Decodes UTF-8 bytes back to a string, accepting either a Uint8Array or an ArrayBuffer directly (e.g. from a binary file read or a fetch response's .arrayBuffer()). As with encode, decoding is a direct byte copy since strings are already raw UTF-8.
differences: UTF-8 only (V1 scope) — non-UTF-8 support (Latin-1/windows-1252, UTF-16, Greek, the rest of the WHATWG label list) is a staged, low-priority follow-on, not started. The `label` argument is WHATWG-normalized (trim + lowercase) and validated against the six UTF-8 aliases: a UTF-8 alias is accepted, and any other label — a bogus one (matching real TextDecoder's RangeError) or a recognized non-UTF-8 encoding this compiler can't transcode — throws a catchable RangeError instead of decoding.
